questions.question: Which natural port is located along the west coast of India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Marmugao.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mormugao is situated in South Goa(West coast) and it is India's natural and oldest port.
 
• It has a deep natural harbour and is the most important port of Goa.
 
• It has contributed largely to the growth of maritime trade in India.
 
• It is one of the **major exporters of iron** ore exporting around 27.3 million tonnes of iron ore.
 
• According to the 2001 census, it has a population of around 97000. The major languages spoken are Kannad, Marathi, Hindi, English, and Konkani is the state language.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Visakhapatnam Port:**

 
 
• It is one of 13 major ports in India and the only major port of **Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• It is a natural port endowed with deepwater basins formed by a high promontory into the sea, known as **Dolphin's Nose Hill to the south and Ross Hill to the North of the entrance channel.**
 
• It is a landlocked port on the** east coast.**
 
 
 
• **​Haldia Port:**
 
 
• It is located at the mouth of the** Hooghly River**.
 
• **Coal, petroleum** including containers, and other heavy goods are imported and exported from Haldia port.
 
 
 
• **Chennai Port:**
 
 
• It is one of the most **ancient ports** which is situated on the easter coast of India.
 
• India's 95% of trading by volume is done through maritime transport.
 
• It stands at** 70% by value**.

questions.question: Which was the first part of India to hold an election based on universal adult franchise?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Manipur.__**

__
 
• **Manipur was the first part of India to hold an election based on a universal adult franchise.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The first general election was held in 1951-52 for over four months. It is from 25 October 1951 to 21 February 1952.
 
• The elections were based on universal adult franchise i.e twenty-one years of age or older having the right to vote.
 
• There were over 173 million voters, most of them poor, illiterate, and rural, and have had no experience of elections.
 
• The first general elections were marked by an active election campaign by Jawaharlal Nehru.

questions.question: Which one of the following is the largest valley in Asia?

• It forms a nearly 1,000 km2 (390 sq mi) plain within a local drainage basin of fewer than 3,000 km2 (1,200 sq mi). It is drained by the Babai River and is one of the largest Inner Terai valleys.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

questions.question: Bangladesh was a part of Pakistan from ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__1947-1971.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bangladesh (East-Pakistan) was part of Pakistan from 1947 to 1971.**
 
• The Government of India decided on** 3rd December 1971**, that India would go to war with Pakistan to save Bengali Muslims and Hindus.
 
• **On 16th December 1971**, the chief of the Pakistani forces with 93,000 soldiers had surrendered unconditionally to the allied forces consisting of the Indian Army and Mukti Bahini in Dhaka.
 
• **Vijay Diwas** is observed on** 16th December **every year in Bangladesh and India, to observe Bangladesh's victory over Pakistan in the War of 1971 for the liberation of Bangladesh from Pakistan and to show respect to Freedom fighters, and Martyrs who take part to free Bangladesh from the atrocious rule of Pakistan.

questions.question: In which of the following years did the Santhal Revolt take place?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__1855-56.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Santhal Pargana is the mainland of the famous Santhal rebellion. On 30 June 1855, two Santal rebel leaders, Sidhu and Kanhu Murmu** with the help of Chand and Bhairav, mobilized ten thousand Santals and declared a rebellion against British colonists.
 
• Santhal Parganas comprised a district of the same name, in undivided Bihar state, India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Santhal uprising of 1855:**

 
 
• The Santhals were given land and persuaded to settle in the** foothills of Rajmahal.**
 
• By 1832 a large area of land was demarcated as **Damin-i-Koh**. This was declared to be the land of the Santhals. They were to live within it, practice plough agriculture, and become settled peasants.
 
• The land grant to the Santhals stipulated that at least one-tenth of the area was to be cleared and cultivated within the first ten years.
 
• The territory was surveyed and mapped. Enclosed with boundary pillars, it was separated from both the world of the settled agriculturists of the plains and the Paharias of the hills.
 
• After the demarcation of Damin-i-Koh, Santhal settlements expanded rapidly.
 
• From **40 Santhal villages in the area in 1838, as many as 1,473 villages had come up by 1851.**

questions.question: Which one of the following is a computer virus?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Creeper.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Creeper virus is a computer virus** that is most commonly recognized as the first computer virus.
 
• **In 1971, Bob Thomas at BBN **created Creeper as an experimental self- duplicating program that was intended not to inflict damage on but to illustrate a mobile application.
 
• Creeper was named for a character on the** "Scooby-Doo” **cartoon show, is recognized as the first computer virus.
 
• It was written in **1971 by Bob Thomas of BBN Technologies **and spread through DEC PDP-10 computers on **ARPAnet.**
 
• It used to display the message**, "I'm the creeper, catch me if you can!".​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **ARPANET**:

 
 
• **The ARPANET** is an acronym for Advanced Research Projects Agency Network.
 
• It was an arm of the U.S. Defense Department that funded the development of the Advanced Research Projects Agency Network (ARPANET) in the late 1960s.
 
• Its purpose was to link computers at Pentagon-funded research institu tions with the telephone lines

questions.question: To which of the following Gharanas did the Hindustani classical vocalist Ustad Bade Ghulam Ali Khan belong?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Patiala Gharana.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ustad Bade Ghulam Ali Khan was an Indian Hindustani classical vocalist, from the Patiala Gharana**.
 
• The most common epithet used to describe Ustad Ghulam Ali Khan is** 'Tansen of the 20th century.** Often referred to as Bade (older) Ghulam Ali Khan to differentiate him from other maestros of the same name.
 
• The genius musician was one of the most legendary** thumri vocalists** of all time, who took the Patiala Gharana.
 
• **Born on 2 April 1902 in Kasur (now in Pakistan),** Bade Ghulam Ali Khan belonged to a family of musicians.
 
• He was awarded the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award and the Padma Bhushan in 1962 Ustad Bade Ghulam Ali Khan breathed last on April 25, 1968, at Basheerbagh Palace in Hyderabad.**

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gwalior Gharana**:

 
 
• It is considered the oldest** Khyal Gharana in Indian classical music.**
 
• Gwalior Gharana was founded in the first half of the 19th century.
 
• Gwalior Gharana became popular in India during the reign of the Mughal emperor Akbar.
 
• Mian Tansen was one of the first and most famous vocalists who came from Gwalior.
 
• The word meaning of Gharana is “family" or "lineage".
 
• **The word Gharana was derived from the Sanskrit word Griha, which means "house'.**
 
• Gharana is a community of performers who share a distinctive musical style that traces to a particular instructor or region.
 
 
 
• **Kirana Gharana:**
 
 
• It is one of the most prominent Indian classical khayal gharanas and is associated mostly with the** perfect intonation of notes.**
 
• The gharana's style was further evolved and was established as one of the important styles in modern Indian classical music in the late **19th / early 20th centuries by the musicians Abdul Karim Khan and Abdul Wahid Khan.**
 
• The name of this school of music comes from **Kirana or Kairana, a town and tehsil of Shamli District in Uttar Pradesh.**

questions.question: Due to which of the following reactions are household bleaching agents using phosphorous, sulphur and chlorine formed?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is the **__Disproportionation reaction.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Disproportionation reactions are the reason behind household bleaching agents using phosphorous, sulfur, and chlorine formed.**
 
• **Disproportionation reaction**:
 
 
• A disproportionation reaction is a specific type of redox reaction in which a species is simultaneously reduced and oxidized to form two different products.
 
• Electronic configuration of Cl is 1s²,2s²,2p⁶,3s²,3p⁵
 
• It can exhibit a maximum oxidation state of +7.
 
• In the given question, all three species can exhibit a Disproportionation reaction which simultaneously oxidizes as well as reduce.
 
• ClO - cannot undergo oxidation as +7 is the maximum oxidation state exhibited by Chlorine.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A displacement reaction:**

 
 
• It is a type of reaction in which part of one reactant is replaced by another reactant.
 
• There are two types of displacement reactions.
 
 
• **Single displacement reactions**: These are those reactions in which one reactant replaces part of the other. Eg: Fe + CuSO4 → FeSO4 + Cu.
 
• **Double displacement reactions:** These are those reactions in which the cations and anions in the reactants switch partners to form products. Eg: AgNO3 + NaCl → AgCl + NaNO3.
 
 
 
• A displacement reaction is also known as a** replacement reaction or a metathesis reaction.**
 
 
 
• **Combination reaction:**
 
 
• A combination reaction also termed a synthesis reaction is about two or more reactants or substances combining with each other to form a new product.
 
• Rust, which is a result of a combination reaction of oxygen and iron could serve as one of the examples of a combination reaction.
 
 
 
• **Decomposition reaction:**
 
 
• Those reactions in which a compound splits up into two or simpler substances are known as decomposition reactions.
 
• A decomposition reaction is the opposite of a combination reaction.
 
 
• **Thermal decomposition:**
 
 
• When a decomposition reaction is carried out by heating, it is called thermal decomposition. The decomposition reaction of calcium carbonate into calcium oxide and carbon dioxide is an example of thermal decomposition. Example: 2FeSO4 - Fe2O3 + SO2 + SO3.

questions.question: The concept of fiscal policy is based fundamentally on the ideas of ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__John Maynard Keynes.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **British economist John Maynard Keynes proposed the theory of Fiscal policy.**
 
• He gave a different outlook on macroeconomics and the economic policies of the government.
 
• He is well known for the theory called **'Keynesian Economics'**.
 
• He died on **April 21, 1946.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Milton Friedman:**

questions.question: Which of the following is a primary storage device in a personal computer?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Random-access memory.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Primary storage, also known as** main storage or memory**, is the main area in a computer in which data is stored for quick access by the computer's processor.
 
• In personal computers and workstations, the term** random access memory (RAM)** - or just memory - is used instead of primary or main storage, and the hard disk, diskette, CD, and DVD collectively describe secondary storage or auxiliary storage.
 
• Primary memory is one that is directly attached to the CPU.
 
• In a Memory hierarchy, cache memory and main Memory are directly attached to the CPU.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A **storage device** is a piece of computer hardware used for saving, carrying, and pulling out data.
 
• It can keep and retain information short-term or long-term.
 
• It can be a device inside or outside a computer or server.
 
• Other terms for the storage device are storage medium or storage media.
 
• Examples of storage devices are - **Pen drives, Hard disks, Compact disks, **etc.

questions.question: Which of the following is a pass on the Pir Panjal Range?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Banihal.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Banihal Pass:**

 
 
• Banihal Pass is a mountain pass across the **Pir Panjal Range at a maximum elevation of 2,832 m.**
 
• It connects the Kashmir Valley in the union territory of Jammu and Kashmir to the outer Himalayas and the plains to the south.
 
 
 
• The Pir Panjal ranges:
 
 
• It lies in the Inner Himalayan region, running from east southeast to west-northwest across the states of Himachal Pradesh and Jammu and Kashmir in India, as well as Pakistan, Administered Kashmir in Pakistan, where the average elevation varies from 1,400 m to 4,100 m. 
 
• The Pir Panjal, Dhauladhar, and Mahabharat ranges are a part of the Himachal range.
 
• Pir Panjal is the largest range on the Lesser Himalayas.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Zoji La Pass:**

 
 
• It is in the Zaskar range in the Indian union territory of Ladakh.
 
• The road route from Srinagar to Leh goes through this pass.
 
• It has been created by the Indus River.
 
 
 
• **Khardung La pass:**
 
 
• It is associated with the Ladakh mountain range in Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• The pass on the Ladakh Range lies north of Leh and is the gateway to the Shyok and Nubra valleys and serves as a motorable route from Leh in India to Kashgar in Central Asia.
 
 
 
• **Photu La pass:**
 
 
• It is on the Srinagar-Leh highway of the Himalayan Zanskar Range stand.
 
• This mountain pass is referred to as the highest point on the highway, going beyond the well-known Zoji La.

questions.question: A major portion of 'Sufed Koh' mountain range lies in ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Pakistan.__**

__
 
• **Safed Koh mountain range on the Pakistan-Afghanistan border**, SE of Kabul; rises to 15,620 ft (4,761 m) at Mt. Sikaram.
 
• It parallels the Kabul River. A spur of the range is crossed by the Khyber Pass.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Karakoram:**

 
 
• It is a large mountain range spanning the border between Pakistan, India, and China.
 
• It is located in the regions of Gilgit Baltistan (Pakistan), Ladakh (India), and Xinjiang (China).
 
• The range is having many peaks such as k2 Mount Godwin Austen (8611m), the second-highest peak in the world, and three other peaks like Gasherbrum |(8068 m), Broad peak (8047 m), Gasherbrum II (8035 m).
 
 
 
• **Ladakh range:**
 
 
• It lies to the north of the Leh and is an important part of the trans- Himalayan range.
 
• It merges with the Kailash range in Tibet.
 
• The important passes are Khardung la and Digar la.
 
 
 
• **Zaskar range:**
 
 
• It covers an area of 7000 sq km and has a height between 3500-7000 m.
 
• It separates Zaskar from Ladakh to the northeast. Pir Panjal is a group of mountains in the inner Himalayan region running from east-southeast to west-northwest.
 
• It consists of the area of Himachal Pradesh, Jammu, and Kashmir and Pakistan administered Kashmir.
 
• It has passes such as Pir Panjal pass, Banihal pass, Sinthan pass and Rohtang la pass.
